description: The shared Renovate preset for every Those Who Run v2 repository, which extends it with "extends": ["github>those-who-run/.github"].
Every update waits in one PR per repository per week, which the maintainer reviews and merges by hand; security fixes open at once, in a PR of their own.
tests/test_renovate_preset.py checks the decided values below.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: it would open a PR of its own outside the weekly one.

pre-commit.description: Off by default in Renovate. The hooks are pinned by commit SHA with the tag in a `# frozen:` comment, which Renovate keeps.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Fixes for GitHub's Dependabot alerts: at once, in a PR of their own, never held by the schedule, the group or the cooldown, and never auto-merged.

packageRules.description: The commit hooks run on the maintainer's machine at every commit, so they wait longer, as in v1.
